subject: Demo follow-up: proposed POC charter & kickoff plan (Sparrow AI)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@sparrow.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo follow-up: proposed POC charter & kickoff plan (Sparrow AI)

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Sparrow's primary use cases (clinical note summarization and triage suggestions). Quick recap from our side and a proposal for a 3-week POC that aims to validate latency/throughput, integration, and end-to-end quality against your acceptance criteria.

POC goals (proposed)
- Validate throughput: 500 concurrent chat sessions with median token latency < 300ms for summary generation
- End-to-end quality: F1 > 0.78 on clinical entity extraction and > 85% agreement with Sparrow SME reviews on top-3 suggestions
- Security & privacy: end-to-end encryption, KMS-backed keys, no persistent PHI on hosted logs

Proposed 3-week timeline
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): sign minimal SOW, exchange service account keys, sample dataset (5k de-identified notes)
- Week 1: integration + data ingest; test runs on representative sessions; baseline metrics
- Week 2: workload tuning (batching, caching, quantization profile) + live endpoint tests
- Week 3: evaluation, handoff, and recommendations; wrap-up readout

Ownership
- Sparrow: Evan (Product lead) + Priya (IT / data ingestion)
- Redwood: Olga (Customer lead) + Aditya (SE, technical lead) + Rafael (CS, success metrics)

Attachments: draft POC SOW and onboarding form attached for signature and to collect sample-data specs.

Next steps / asks from you
1) Can you confirm the sample dataset availability and point of contact for S3 access or secure transfer?
2) Any legal/procurement constraints (PO number, PO terms) to surface before Week 0?
3) Do you have a preferred kickoff window next week (we've blocked Tue/Wed 10–12 PT)?

I'll update the SOW with any procurement details once you share them. Happy to adjust the timeline to fit your internal review cycles.

Best,

Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: onboarding-form.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Evan Brooks <evan@sparrow.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@health.sparrow.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: proposed POC charter & kickoff plan (Sparrow AI)

Thanks Olga — appreciate the clear plan.

Quick answers:
- We can provide a 5k sample of de-identified notes by end of week; Priya will own the S3 upload. Priya — I cc'd you to confirm the transfer method.
- Procurement: we typically need a short SOW + PO; procurement@sparrow.ai will issue PO once SOW is signed. I'll loop them in separately.
- Kickoff: Wed 10am PT works for the core team.

One technical ask to capture in the scope: can Redwood provide guidance on tokenization impacts for clinical abbreviations (e.g., "BP" / "b.p.") and whether quantization profiles could degrade clinical phrase fidelity? We'd like that included in Week 2 tuning deliverables.

Evan
VP Product
Sparrow AI

Looping in a couple of internal notes before kickoff.

Suggested evaluation metrics (we should track and present):
- Latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for summary endpoint
- Token throughput (tokens/sec) and cost per 1k tokens (projected)
- Quality: precision/recall for entity extraction; SME agreement rate for suggestions
- Error rates: 4xx/5xx rate and root-cause classification (model vs infra)

Data checklist for Priya:
- sample_manifest.csv (s3:// or secure link)
- schema for notes (fields: note_id, timestamp, clinician_id [optional], text)
- any PHI flags/pseudonymization notes

I'll prepare a short scorecard template (single-sheet) for the Week 3 readout. Also suggest we include a small live-run acceptance test: 50 randomized notes and Sparrow SME blind-review.

Rafael
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
